note: A bank's ONLINE ACTIVITY PRINT-OUT, the layout a reviewer actually uploaded - a different genre from a mailed statement, not a dialect of one. V38's pack fixed classification (the online vocabulary); V39's schema fixed two of the three fields the genre states, where 1.3.0 captured NOTHING AT ALL. Run against the real document (2026-09-02) the third - the balance - was still MISSING with its classification anchor lit: the print-out states it as a TILE, the amount in a larger face with its caption directly beneath, and V39's rung looked to the RIGHT of the caption. V40 adds LABEL_ABOVE (LABEL_BELOW's vertical mirror) and 1.5.0 appends it to endingBalance; this fixture now draws the balance block the way the document prints it, with the real neighbouring tiles: 'Deposits this month' in the position the real neighbour occupies (so the cell window is proven to keep its amount out) and 'Withdrawals this month' beside it. Those two are calendar-month-to-date figures for a window the document never states - not totals of the activity listed - so totalDeposits/totalWithdrawals must walk past them - while 1.6.0 (V41) reads the same two tiles into monthToDateDeposits/monthToDateWithdrawals, as printed with their signs, the withdrawals caption wrapping around the fourth tile's caption exactly as the real page does; the headline 'Available balance' nets out holds and nothing reads it. Six fields stay deliberately MISSING and they are the more valuable half of this case: a print-out states no period, no opening balance and no totals, so truth declares them NONE and capturing anything there is the failure - which pins that no rung reaches past its anchor into the transaction rows below, where dates and money would satisfy every one of those patterns.
